theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fcl_dist_sublevel_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U C : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → C.Nonempty → ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ δ₀ → IsCompact {x | infDist x C ≤ r} ∧ {x | infDist x C ≤ r} ⊆ U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
